originalInput.project: Synthetic print room · one supplied operating day

policies.label: Printing press
policies.description: Printing press machine producing ink printed paper sheets.

policies.label: Paper dryer
policies.description: Hot air drying oven curing ink on printed paper sheets.

policies.label: Exhaust ventilation
policies.description: Exhaust fan extracting room air and ink fumes.

policies.label: Work lighting
policies.description: Ceiling task lamps lighting the printing work room.
